name: @penguinharness/skillopt-rsi-toolkit
description: SkillOpt RSI Toolkit: evolve a reusable Skill through bounded edits, candidate evaluation and cross-epoch reflection, then compare frozen baseline and final States.

penguin.description_zh: SkillOpt RSI 工具包：通过有界文本编辑、候选评测和跨轮反思优化可复用 Skill，再比较冻结的 baseline 与 final。
penguin.short_description: SkillOpt RSI Toolkit: bounded Skill edits with score-based selection.
penguin.short_description_zh: SkillOpt RSI 工具包：限制编辑幅度，按评分选择技能。

quick_start.prompt: Read skillopt-rsi-toolkit and run a SkillOpt experiment on the selected Benchmarks with the requested model and budget.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 读取 skillopt-rsi-toolkit，按指定模型和预算，在选定的 Benchmark 上完成 SkillOpt 实验。
